summary: Info Sheet #64 Data/Analytics/Reporting Export Engine tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed (options, generate JSON+CSV, share/token creation, public download w/ increment + 410 after max_downloads, 404 on unknown token, HTML report, admin KPIs + jobs, non-admin 403, audit 'data_export' event logged). Frontend E2E on mobile viewport 390x844: demo_home login -> Profile -> profile-export -> /export screen; all 12 testIDs present (export-back, export-type-* x7, export-format-json/csv, export-download, export-share); JSON copy, CSV copy, and share flows all triggered POST /api/export/generate 200 and share flow opened GET /api/export/report/{token} 200 in a new tab. Admin flow: Diyhomieapp login -> /admin -> admin-nav-export -> ExportModule renders KPI grid (Users 123, Projects 76, Completions 82, Exports 6, Audit events 199, Member savings $3,125), 'Copy KPIs (JSON)' testID export-copy-kpis present and tappable, 'Recent user exports (6)' list populated with user_name/types/format/date/download counts.

issues: Admin workstation is desktop-optimised; KPI cards width 31% + horizontal-scrolling nav tabs render fine on narrow mobile but 'Data & Reports' tab is partially clipped until user scrolls the nav horizontally. Not a blocker.

action_items: No fixes required for Sheet #64. Feature is production-ready.

(Optional cleanup — unrelated to #64) Expo version warnings persist: expo 54.0.34->54.0.35, expo-font 14.0.11->14.0.12, expo-router 6.0.23->6.0.24. Consider running `npx expo install --check` when convenient.
critical_code_review_comments: export_engine.py is well-scoped (~266 lines, single-responsibility). All Mongo reads project out `_id`. All endpoints use env-driven db. Audit logging is fire-and-forget (log_event catches exceptions). Good.

report() endpoint returns HTTP 410 for ANY error including 'not_found'. Spec item stated unknown token 'returns 404' for download and unspecified for report; current behaviour (410 HTML for report on unknown token) is acceptable UX since a printable report has no meaningful 404 body. Documented as-is — no change needed unless product prefers a 404 status for unknown report tokens.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Used demo_home's existing data (13 projects, 23 timeline, 4 certs, 21 notifications, 125 audit events, 4 skills, 2 campaigns). Test run created ~4 export_jobs (safe, expiring).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sheet #64 export engine complete and green. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_export_engine_sheet64.py (14 tests, all pass). Uses BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env or falls back to reading /app/frontend/.env. Note: on web the frontend uses expo Alert.alert which does NOT surface as a browser dialog event, so Playwright's page.on('dialog') will not fire; verify UI success via network calls (backend logs) instead. Login route is /auth?mode=login; login submit button text is 'LOG IN' (uppercase).
